offering_description.value: Planet Fitness franchises and operates low-cost gyms for consumers. Members get access to exercise equipment, fitness instruction and digital workouts. The company licenses its gym format to franchise operators, supports their clubs and supplies them with commercial fitness equipment.

primary_products.value: commercial cardio equipment; commercial strength-training equipment

primary_services.value: gym memberships; small-group fitness instruction; digital workouts; franchise licensing and operating support

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals seeking affordable gym memberships; B2B: Fitness club franchise owners and operators

end_markets.value: consumer fitness and recreation; fitness club franchising

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Franchisees pay initial franchise fees and ongoing royalties; subscription: Members pay monthly dues and annual fees at company-operated gyms; product sales: Franchisees buy commercial cardio and strength-training equipment; other: Franchisees contribute to a national marketing fund
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; subscription; product sales; other

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Provides franchise systems and operating support to independent gym operators; asset operator: Equips and runs company-operated gyms for paying members; distributor: Sources commercial fitness equipment from manufacturers and sells it to franchisees

geography_served.value: global: United States and Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Australia and Spain

specialization.value: related lines: Gym franchising, company-operated gyms and fitness equipment supply to franchisees

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Independently operated franchise gyms; own locations: Company-operated gyms that enroll and serve members; online: Website for membership enrollment and mobile app for digital workouts; direct sales: Franchise agreements and equipment sales directly to gym operators
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; own locations; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State health club contract laws, consumer protection rules for recurring billing, and workplace safety requirements
